outcome: Prevalence of chronic diabetes complications (chronic kidney disease, neuropathy, peripheral vascular disease, diabetic retinopathy)
cohort: Delivery hospitalizations in the United States National Inpatient Sample between 2000 and 2019
finding: Pregestational diabetes mellitus increased over the study period, driven by a quadrupling in the prevalence of type 2 diabetes mellitus, and was associated with a range of adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Pregestational diabetes mellitus was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
